label: Platform
description: Transcribe all WAV audio files in a directory with a cloud ASR model (whisper-large-v3 via OpenRouter), write each transcript as a .txt file next to the audio, and return the individual and combined transcripts. Existing .txt files in the directory are reused, so re-running on the same meeting does not transcribe a second time.

directoryPath.description: Absolute path to the directory containing .wav files. The .txt transcripts are written into this same directory.

model.description: Transcription model to use. Defaults to 'openai/whisper-large-v3'.

language.description: ISO-639-1 language code of the spoken audio. Defaults to 'tr'.

force.description: Re-transcribe even when a .txt transcript already exists, overwriting it. Defaults to false.

full_meeting_transcript.description: Combined transcript of all audio files in order.

label: Platform
description: Summarize a meeting into a structured Turkish summary: an overall summary paragraph, the highlights, and the next steps. Receives both the combined transcript and each participant's own recording, so statements and next step owners are attributed to the right speaker

full_meeting_transcript.description: Combined transcript from transcribe_meeting, giving the chronological flow of the meeting.

speaker_transcripts.description: Each participant's individual transcript, from transcribe_meeting's output. Pass this array through unchanged - it is what makes speaker attribution possible.

summary.description: A 3-5 sentence paragraph covering the purpose of the meeting, the main topics and how it ended.

highlights.description: The key points, requests, proposals and decisions for this topic.
Important meeting topics, each with its own list of highlights.

next_steps.description: Concrete action items, each as '<owner>, <what they will do>' with the deadline appended when the transcript states one.

label: Platform
description: Write the full meeting transcript, each speaker's transcript and the LLM judge's evaluation to .txt files on disk, and return them as a list of email attachment descriptors ({ filename, path }) that can be passed straight to GREY:send_email. Meeting audio is NOT attached unless includeAudio is explicitly turned on

directoryPath.description: Absolute path to the meeting directory containing the .wav files. Transcript .txt files and the audio zip are written into its 'attachments' subdirectory.

full_meeting_transcript.description: Combined transcript from transcribe_meeting. Pass through unchanged.

speaker_transcripts.description: Each participant's individual transcript from transcribe_meeting. Pass this array through unchanged.

participants.description: Optional participants list from meeting metadata, used to put real names in the transcript file names.

judgement.description: The LLM judge's result from PLATFORM:judge_summary. Pass it through unchanged and it is written to a .txt file and attached alongside the transcripts.

includeAudio.description: Whether to bundle the .wav audio files into meeting-audio.zip and attach it. Defaults to false - meeting audio is not emailed.

maxTotalBytes.description: Total attachment size budget in bytes. Attachments that would exceed it are reported in 'skipped' instead of attached. Defaults to 20971520 (20MB).

attachments.description: Attachment descriptors to pass unchanged to GREY:send_email's 'attachments' parameter.

audioArchive.description: Details of the generated audio zip, only present when includeAudio was turned on.

skipped.description: Attachments left out because of the size budget.

label: Platform
description: Replace participant IDs with their real names, anywhere they appear (recursively) inside a text transcript or a structured summary object, using a participants list from metadata

content.description: The transcript string or structured summary object (e.g. output of summarize_meeting_by_speaker) containing participant IDs to resolve.

participants.description: Array of participant objects from meeting metadata.

content.description: The same input shape (string or object), with IDs replaced by participant names.

label: Platform
description: Summarize a full meeting transcript into a structured Turkish summary: an overall summary paragraph and the highlights. Works from the combined transcript alone, with no per-speaker recording, and deliberately produces no next steps

transcript.description: The full meeting transcript to turn into meeting notes.

summary.description: A 3-5 sentence paragraph covering the purpose of the meeting, the main topics and how it ended.

highlights.description: The key points, requests, proposals and decisions for this topic.
Important meeting topics, each with its own list of highlights.

label: Platform
description: Evaluate meeting notes with a Turkish LLM judge prompt. Returns 0-100 scores for the meeting summary, next steps, topics, highlights, overall quality and accuracy, plus a short Turkish justification. Next steps are not evaluated for variant A because that variant does not generate them.

transcript.description: The meeting transcript the notes are judged against. Pass full_meeting_transcript from transcribe_meeting through unchanged.

summary.description: The generated meeting summary text. For backward compatibility, the whole summarization result object is also accepted.

highlights.description: The highlights array from the summarization step. Pass it through unchanged so topics and highlights can be evaluated.

next_steps.description: The next_steps array from the summarization step. Required at runtime for variants that generate next steps; omit it for variant A.

speaker_transcripts.description: Optional. Each participant's individual transcript from transcribe_meeting. Pass it whenever the summary attributes statements or next steps to specific speakers, so the judge can verify those attributions instead of marking them unsupported - the combined transcript alone carries no speaker labels.

variant.description: Label of the summarization variant being judged (e.g. 'A', 'B'), echoed back in the output.

meeting_summary.description: 0-100: how well the meeting summary reflects the purpose, developments, decisions and outcomes.

next_steps.description: 0-100: completeness and accuracy of the next steps. Null for variant A because next steps are not evaluated.

topics.description: 0-100: completeness and correct organization of the main topics.

highlights.description: 0-100: whether critical decisions and important points were selected correctly.

overall.description: 0-100: holistic usability score; it cannot exceed the accuracy score.

accuracy.description: 0-100: how well the claims in the notes are supported by the transcript and available speaker recordings.

reasoning.description: A Turkish evaluation of at most 150 words identifying concrete strengths and weaknesses.

label: Platform
description: Create a virtual machine (EC2 instance) on AWS. If no AMI is given, the latest Amazon Linux 2023 image is used.

amiId.description: AMI ID to launch from. Defaults to the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI.

keyName.description: Name of an existing EC2 key pair for SSH access (optional).

region.description: AWS region. Defaults to the AWS_REGION environment variable.

label: Platform
description: Terminate a virtual machine (EC2 instance) on AWS by instance ID. Termination is permanent and cannot be undone.

instanceId.description: The ID of the EC2 instance to terminate (e.g. 'i-0abc123def456...').

region.description: AWS region the instance is in. Defaults to the AWS_REGION environment variable.

label: Platform
description: Deterministically evaluate an OTLP resourceMetrics payload against metric reference ranges. Pass the incoming OTLP payload as 'metrics' and the reference ranges (e.g. from agent knowledge) as 'reference_ranges'. Each data point is matched to its reference by metric name and attributes, then checked against min/max bounds or an expected value. Returns the out-of-range metrics as violations.

metrics.description: OTLP resourceMetrics payload from the incoming message, either as a JSON object with a 'resourceMetrics' array or as a JSON string.

reference_ranges.description: Reference ranges to evaluate against, e.g. from agent knowledge. A list of objects with 'metric' and optional 'attributes', 'min', 'max', 'expected', 'unit'. A single range object or a JSON string is also accepted.

checked.description: Number of data points evaluated against a reference.

hasViolations.description: True when at least one metric is outside its reference range.

violations.description: Out-of-range metrics with observed value, allowed range and timestamp.

label: Platform
description: Look up all knowledge entries for this agent. Returns every knowledge item including TEXT, QA, and DATA types. Always use this before making decisions that depend on facts that may have been updated by a supervisor, such as product certificates or policies.

agentId.description: The agent the knowledge belongs to.

knowledge.description: Every knowledge entry the agent has.
